description: This PHP file defines a controller class `ProductPurchased` within the OpenCart framework, specifically in the admin extension for reports. It handles the display, saving, and retrieval of a product purchased report, including methods for rendering views and processing report data.

classes.name: ProductPurchased
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'Product Purchased' report in the OpenCart admin panel, including rendering report views, handling save operations, and generating report data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main report form page, setting up breadcrumbs, loading language, configuration, and common layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report settings via POST request, with permission validation and JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the actual report page with report data and order statuses.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the report list view, primarily used for AJAX or pagination.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves filtered report data, handles pagination, and renders the report list view.
